Four release rows fell out of the matrix table

PR 4138 appended rows for Claude Code 2.1.269 to 2.1.272 to the doctor compatibility matrix. A blank line already sat after the last row. In GitHub flavored Markdown a blank line ends a table, so the new rows rendered as loose text below it. This PR deletes that blank line and corrects one count: 2.1.269 adds five settings or environment controls, and per-command allowed_domains belongs to 2.1.271.
